faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Are the accounts sold here safe?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% safe. All accounts we sell go through a strict screening process and come with a lifetime anti-hackback guarantee.
faq.q2: How long is the transaction process?
faq.a2: The process is instant. As soon as payment is confirmed, you will immediately receive full access to the account.
faq.q3: Can I pay using E-Wallet or Bank Transfer?
faq.a3: Of course! We accept payments via BCA, Mandiri, GoPay, OVO, Dana, and ShopeePay.
faq.a4: Currently we do not accept trade-ins, we only focus on direct buying and selling for maximum security.
